policy.scope: Structural metadata reconciliation; no new hardware measurements or write support.
policy.classification: A category accounts for the difference; it does not resolve unknown semantics.
policy.referenceRanges: FM3_RANGES is an independent source claim; its historical raw captures are not replayed here.
policy.addressSafety: Never infer FM3 parameter IDs from another device or a guessed GLOBAL offset.

categories.high-id-editor-control: High ID (>=0xFF00), outside ordinary block words; editor/action interpretation needs its own mapping.
categories.global-address-gap: GLOBAL address absent from the other source. No guessed offset or cross-device substitution.
categories.midi-row-action: MIDIBLOCK_TEST_ROW action outside the 0..256 scalar table; separate action semantics.
categories.family-absent-from-table: Family exists in the catalog but is absent from this dictionary; this does not establish device availability.
categories.catalog-address-gap: Remaining named address absent from the dictionary; requires source-specific investigation.
categories.global-slot-without-name: GLOBAL descriptor has no catalog symbol; descriptor shape does not identify its function.
categories.midi-slot-without-scalar-definition: Unnamed MIDI table slot marked unused/n/a; not an individual knob measurement.
categories.unnamed-family: Descriptor block has no family mapping; do not transfer an ID from another device.
categories.unnamed-unused-slot: Unnamed descriptor explicitly marked unused/n/a; retained as a slot, not a supported control.
categories.unnamed-active-descriptor: Unnamed descriptor has a curve or options, but its semantic identity remains unresolved.
categories.named-dictionary-gap: Named dictionary entry is absent from the catalog; requires a reviewed symbol join.
